bonuses: • Starts with ${ZEUS_STARTING_FAVOR_BONUS} Favor.
• Gains Favor ${ZEUS_FAVOR_SPEED}% faster.
• Myth units cost ${ZEUS_MYTH_UNIT_COST} less population.
• Infantry do +${ZEUS_INFANTRY_BUILDING_DAMAGE_BONUS}% damage to buildings.
• Hoplites move ${ZEUS_HOPLITES_MOVEMENT_BONUS}% faster.
• ${HADES_FALLEN_SHADE_RETURN_CHANCE}% chance for fallen humans to return as Shades.
• Myth units gain +${HADES_MYTH_UNIT_HP_BONUS}% hitpoints per age.
• Ranged soldiers and heroes +${HADES_RANGED_BONUS} range and +${HADES_LOS_BONUS} LoS.
• Ranged fortifications +${HADES_RANGED_FORITIFATION_RANGE_BONUS} range.
• Ranged Soldier upgrades cost -${HADES_RANGED_SOLDIER_UPGRADES}%.
• Militia spawn from razed buildings.
• Cavalry, Caravans, and Myth Units gain +${POSEIDON_UNITS_SPEED_BONUS} speed per age.
• Stables and Markets are ${POSEIDON_STABLE_MARKET_CHEAP}% cheaper.
• Market exchange rates improved by ${POSEIDON_MARKET_RATE_IMPROVEMENT}%.
• A free Hippocampus respawns at the first Dock.
• Herdables improve Favor gather rate when near a Temple. (max. ${DEMETER_MAX_TEMPLE_CAP} herdables per Temple)
• Town and Village Centers spawn Herdables on age up.
• Village Centers train units ${DEMETER_VILLAGE_CENTER_TRAIN_SPEED}% faster.
• Herdables fatten +${DEMETER_HERDABLE_FATTENING_RATE}% faster, and can fatten +${DEMETER_HERDABLE_FOOD_CAP}% more.
• Human soldiers and myth units train +${DEMETER_TRAIN_SPEED}% faster per age.
• Laborers gather from Berry Bushes ${RA_GATHER_BONUS}% faster.
• +${RA_HP_BONUS}% Camel Rider, Chariot Archer, and War Elephant hitpoints.
• Pharaoh-empowered Monuments empower nearby buildings (${RA_PHARAOH_EFFICIENCY}% efficiency of Pharaohs).
• Priests can empower (${RA_PHARAOH_EFFICIENCY}% efficiency of Pharaohs).
• Town Centers and Citadel Centers support +${ISIS_TOWN_CENTER_POPULATION_BONUS} population.
• Monuments shield against enemy God Powers (${ISIS_MONUMENT_SHIELD_RANGE} range; ${ISIS_MONUMENT_SHIELD_RANGE_EMPOWERED} when empowered).
• Empowered Monuments heal nearby units (${ISIS_MONUMENT_HEAL_RANGE} range) and generate Favor ${ISIS_FAVOR_GEN_SPEED}% faster.
• Technologies cost -${ISIS_TECH_COST_REDUCTION}%.
• Obelisks cost -${ISIS_OBELISK_COST} Gold, and are built ${ISIS_OBELISK_BUILD_SPEED}% faster.
• Pharaohs can summon Animals of Set.
• Priests can convert wild animals, but converted animals lose ${SET_CONVERT_FOOD_LOSS}% of their Food.
• +${SET_UNIT_SPEED_BONUS}% Spearman, Axeman, and Slinger speed.
• Barracks, Siege Works, and Migdol Strongholds cost -${SET_BUILDING_COST}% Gold.
• Monuments reduce the cost of units in nearby Barracks and Migdol Strongholds by ${SET_BUILDING_UNIT_COST_REDUCTION}%.
• Start with Dwarves instead of Gatherers.
• Dwarves cost -${THOR_DWARVE_COST_REDUCTION} Gold, and gather Food and Wood nearly as fast as Gatherers.
• Dwarven Armory can be built and research upgrades in any age.
• Armory upgrades cost -${THOR_ARMORY_COST_REDUCTION}% less.
• Receive a free Dwarf for each Dwarven Armory upgrade researched.
• Can research ${THOR_EXTRA_DWARVEN_ARMORY_UPGRADES} extra Dwarven Armory upgrades.
• Gatherers and Dwarves hunt ${ODIN_GATHERER_DWARVEN_HUNT_BONUS}% faster.
• Great Hall units generate +${ODIN_GREAT_HALL_FAVOR_GENERATE}% Favor in battle.
• Human units and heroes regenerate ${ODIN_HUMAN_HERO_HP_REGEN} hitpoints/second.
• ${ODIN_RAVEN_SCOUT_SPAWNS} Raven scouts spawn once the first Temple is built, and respawn a short time after being killed.
• Damaging enemy units can spawn myth units. (Human soldiers contribute ${LOKI_HUMAN_CONTRIBUTION}%; Hersirs ${LOKI_HERSIRS_CONTRIBUTION}% of damage dealt.)
• Human soldiers and heroes +${LOKI_HUMAN_HERO_COUNTER_DAMAGE}% counter damage.
• Buildings are constructed ${LOKI_BUILDING_SPEED_BONUS}% faster.
• Ox Carts are ${LOKI_OXCART_COST_REDUCTION}% cheaper.
• Transforming Gatherers and Dwarves into Berserks is ${LOKI_BERSERK_TRANSFORM_COST_REDUCTION}% cheaper.
• Has a potent defensive God Power that gets more powerful with each age advancement.
• Technologies cost -${FREYR_TECHNOLOGY_COST}% Food, Wood, and Gold, but take ${FREYR_TECHNOLOGY_RESEARCH_DURATION}% longer to research.
• Hill Forts and Hill Fort units +${FREYR_HILL_FORTS_UNITS_DAMAGE_BONUS}% damage.
• Repairing buildings is free.
• Gatherers and Dwarves can repair.
• Can time-shift buildings to new locations (Towers & Palaces cost ${KRONOS_TOWER_PALACE_SHIFT_COST}% of their price to shift, others are free).
• Buildings are constructed ${KRONOS_MANOR_CONSTRUCTION_SPEED_BONUS}% faster per nearby Manor.
• Receive ${KRONOS_FREE_MYTH_UNIT_COUNT} free myth units instead of 1 when advancing to the next age.
• Lost siege and myth units return ${KRONOS_LOST_SIEGE_MYTH_UNITS_COST_RETURN}% of their resource cost.
• Citizens can build a new Sky Passage each age.
• Units can enter Sky Passages to instantly teleport between them.
• All units have +${ORANOS_UNIT_LOS_BONUS} Line of Sight.
• Oracles generate +${ORANOS_ORACLE_LOS_FAVOR_BONUS}% Favor at full Line of Sight.
• Damaged enemy units remain visible for ${ORANOS_DAMAGED_UNITS_VISIBLE_DURATION} seconds.
• Start with Hero Citizens and promoting Citizens to heroes costs -${GAIA_CITIZEN_HERO_PROMOTION_COST_REDUCTION}%.
• The Economic Guild and its technologies are ${GAIA_GUILD_TECHNOLOGIES_COST_REDUCTION}% cheaper, and can be researched an age earlier.
• Economic Buildings (Town Centers, Manors, Economic Guilds, and Markets) grow Lush.
• Lush heals friendly units and buildings (${GAIA_LUSH_FRIENDLY_HEALING} HP/second).
• God Blessing: Yin and Yang
• On Favored Land: Buildings research ${FUXI_FAVORED_LAND_RESEARCH_SPEED}% faster and Military Camp/Machine Workshop additions cost -${FUXI_ADDONS_COST_REDUCTION}%.
• Gains access to Nezha in the Classical Age, an additional legendary hero that gets stronger each age.
• God Blessing: Creator’s Auspice
• On Favored Land: Foundations automatically construct.
• Buildings spread Favored Land +${NUWA_FAVORED_LAND_SPREAD_INCREASE} range further.
• Cavalry +10% hitpoints.
• God Blessing: Gift of Beasts
• On Favored Land: Myth units recover ${SHENNONG_MYTH_UNIT_REGEN} hitpoints per second, increasing by ${SHENNONG_MYTH_UNIT_REGEN} per age.
• Farms are available in Archaic Age, and build instantly on favored land.
• Plow, Irrigation, and Flood Control are researched instantly for free in their respective ages.
• Earns an increasing Gold trickle with each Bushidō tier.
• Samurai and Onna-mushas earn ${AMATERASU_PASSIVE_XP_BONUS}% more XP outside of combat.
• Shrines increase the content of nearby resources, up to ${AMATERASU_RESOURCE_INVENTORY_CAP}%.
• Samurai and Onna-mushas regenerate hitpoints (${AMATERASU_COMBAT_REGEN_MULTIPLIER}x faster in combat).
• Increases Shinobi and Cavalry attack with each Bushidō tier.
• Each technology researched grants Bushidō XP.
• Advancing to the next Age is ${TSUKUYOMI_FASTER_AGE_ADVANCEMENT}% faster.
• A free Kitsune appears at the Temple each Age.
• Tributes a larger Favor reward with each Bushidō tier.
• Myth units earn Bushidō XP passively, and through combat.
• Invoking a God Power makes others ${SUSANOO_GOD_POWER_COST_REDUCTION}% cheaper to reinvoke.
• Unit special abilities recharge ${SUSANOO_UNIT_RECHARGE_TIME}% faster.
• Temples, Great Temples, Village- and Town Centers refund ${HUITZILOPOCHTLI_BUILDING_COST_REDUCTION}% of their cost upon completion.
• Collecting tonalli earns resources in addition to Favor equal to ${HUITZILOPOCHTLI_TONALLI_RESOURCE_REWARD}% of the defeated unit's cost.
• Shorn Ones have +${HUITZILOPOCHTLI_SHORN_ONE_HITPOINTS}% hitpoints and generate +${HUITZILOPOCHTLI_SHORN_ONES_TONALLI}% more tonalli in combat.
• Every ${TEZCATLIPOCA_MYTH_UNIT_INTERVAL} Myth Units lost spawn an Obsidian Shard; if the Shard survives long enough, it summons a free Myth Unit of the current age.
• Tzompantli Towers and Traps are built ${TEZCATLIPOCA_TOWER_BUILD_TIME}% faster and inflict +${TEZCATLIPOCA_TOWER_DAMAGE}% damage.
• Devoting Settlers grants +${TEZCATLIPOCA_DEVOTION_ARCHAIC}%/+${TEZCATLIPOCA_DEVOTION_CLASSICAL}%/+${TEZCATLIPOCA_DEVOTION_HEROIC}%/+${TEZCATLIPOCA_DEVOTION_MYTHIC}% more Favor per age.
• Jaguar Riders are unlocked an age earlier.
• Warrior Priests generate ${QUETZALCOATL_BLOODLETTING} Favor per second by performing Bloodletting at Temples.
• Calpullis and their additions cost -${QUETZALCOATL_CALPULLI_DISCOUNT}%.
• Nobles' Hut units +${QUETZALCOATL_NOBLES_HUT_HP}% hitpoints.
• Eagle Warriors gain +${QUETZALCOATL_EAGLE_WARRIOR_RANGE} Range and Line of Sight in the Heroic and Mythic ages.
